operatorNotes: The window is TERMINAL ON A P5 PAUSE, and that is the whole finding: all five precommitted items were started, executed exactly once and completed normally, but two of the five produced zero raw page evidence, which is 2 of a frozen denominator of 5 and therefore above the 30% arm. The landed gate returned PAUSE_P5_LOW_RAW_YIELD after the fifth item rather than WINDOW_COMPLETE.
Because the pause fired on the LAST item, it suppressed no work. No sixth item existed, nothing was skipped, and no item was started after it.

The two zero-yield items failed for DIFFERENT reasons, and both are honest capability limits rather than defects. P:42 read a 301 at /robots.txt whose target path is "/" rather than "/robots.txt"; the landed continuationTargetFor requires an exact /robots.txt target, so it returned null and no continuation request was issued, leaving the policy genuinely unread. The target was same-registrable-domain and host-changing, so neither the registrable-domain arm nor the scheme arm was the binding one. P:45 failed DNS on its /robots.txt request, one observation, error kind DNS_FAILURE.

Both zero-yield items therefore carry rootTerminalReason ROBOTS_UNREADABLE_ROOT, but their underlying evidence differs: P:42 has a recorded 301 redirect observation and no transport error, P:45 has a transport error and no redirect. The later adjudication must apply Q3 precedence to each on its own evidence and must not treat the shared root terminal reason as a shared reason.

Three of the five items ended at PAGE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with exactly 35 page attempts, which is the frozen MAX_PAGE_ATTEMPTS_PER_ROOT ceiling reached rather than exceeded. No item exceeded any ceiling.

P:44 is the only item whose SD7 count is a genuine range ([27, 28]): one exact duplicate group removed one row, three near-duplicate edges were found and one page falls under the short-text threshold and is therefore not measurable. The range is preserved complete and was not collapsed to an exact value, and it does not cross 4.

No item selected a Track A or Track B page anywhere in this window, even on the three items that read 26 to 31 pages each. That is recorded as an observation only; it is not adjudicated here and no ruleset conclusion is drawn from it. It is, however, the kind of observation a later shadow validation of orgunit-signal-rules-v1 would want.

No candidate row in this window carries a negative score, so migration 0008's dropped lower bound was not exercised by this window. That is an observation, not evidence that the constraint was unnecessary.

The entire window ran on BATTERY with no AC adapter attached, under the owner power-source correction recorded in the bound live authority. Battery fell from 85% to 79% across the window and never approached the 20% floor; the lid stayed open and no Sleep, Wake or DarkWake event occurred at any point.
